ops.text: Phase 4 kind half shipped: cc-guides yml renderable kind is on main as 10ba3f3, auto-released as v0.1.23 (Release/Guides/CI all green). Review story: finder A (routing/kind-semantics lens) returned zero findings after tracing every Kind switch site; finder B (lint/tests lens) found 2 — (1) MAJOR, confirmed + fixed: LintYAML collapsed every {{token}} to the same neutral "0" scalar, and yaml.v3's duplicate-key check then falsely rejected fragments keyed by two distinct tokens (also collided with a literal 0 key); fix replaces each token with its own name (compose.go's m[2:len(m)-2] idiom), regression-tested both directions (distinct token keys + literal 0 sibling pass; the SAME token twice as mapping keys still fails, correctly — it renders to a genuine duplicate). (2) MINOR, accepted as known limitation: lint's neutral substitution can't represent arbitrary render-time args — identical gap exists in the shipped LintJSON precedent; lint is a well-formedness smoke, not a render simulation. Refuter agents died on the account session limit (resets 7:20pm PT); finding 1 was verified by direct reproduction + tests instead, finding 2 adjudicated at the fable tier. Also: a dead refuter left guide/zz_refute_test.go behind (broke gofumpt) — removed. Push required a rebase over the fleet's v0.1.22 re-render chore commit (attributes bypassed per the mergiraf hazard). action-v1 untouched. Fragment-ization deliberately deferred until the pilot lands (fragments adopt piloted content verbatim).
